description: NiFi provides these artifacts at runtime, so their versions must match the ones the NiFi distribution ships.
They are set through the jedis.version and spring.data.redis.version properties and are updated with the NiFi version, never on their own.
Renovate does not regenerate the --hash values in requirements-test.txt, and the python-tests workflow installs it with pip --require-hashes.
A version bump on its own would fail that job.
Each Dockerfile pins its base image through a version ARG and a separate digest ARG, which Renovate cannot update as one dependency.
Base images are upgraded by hand together with the NiFi version.
